"},{"path":"storyscenes/mini_adventures/kite/reference_story.md","content":"# The Last Bright Bar

At four o’clock, the family campsite smelled of pine needles, toast, and the damp towels Mom had hung between two trees. Mira was old enough to help with the tent and young enough to want Dad to notice. She had tightened every peg that morning. Kit, her little brother, had made a blanket cave beside the bedrolls and put his stuffed fox, Pip, in charge.

Mira hoped Dad would let her lead the short walk to the washroom after supper. He usually said she hurried when Kit was with her. Kit hoped nobody would move the bedrolls before he found Pip. They wanted different things, but for now their small campsite felt like a whole country they had made together.

A gust lifted the blanket cave. Kit crawled out to rescue Pip, then helped Mira carry a cup to the picnic table. He was sure he had tucked the fox under the folded rainfly by the tent. He did not notice the soft toy slipping from his jacket pocket when he bent to pick up a pinecone.

By the time the sun touched the ridge, Kit had checked the sleeping bags twice. He looked beneath the table, then under his own knees. “Pip’s gone,” he said. His voice had gone thin. The trees beyond the tent had grown long, dark shadows, and Kit kept glancing at them as if something there might have borrowed the fox.

Mira wanted to say it was only a toy. Instead she looked at his empty hands. “We’ll find him before supper.” Kit pressed his lips together. “You said that about my blue sock.” “That sock was in your boot.” “It was a very sneaky sock.” He almost smiled, but his eyes still watched the tree line.

Dad was stirring a pot at the fire. Mira asked to borrow the battery lantern from the picnic table. “The tent’s bright enough,” he said, “but the path will be dim soon. Take it, stay together, and bring it back before I serve supper.” Mira promised. The lantern was heavier than she expected, warm from the afternoon sun.

She switched it on. Its circle of light spread over Kit’s shoes and the tent wall. Kit stepped behind her. “The trees are bigger when it gets late,” he murmured. Mira felt a prickly wish to prove she was not scared either. She could have marched off alone and called it brave. Instead, she waited until he stood beside her.

On the tent wall, their shadows stretched up like giants. Mira made two ears with her fingers. “That’s Pip,” Kit said. His shadow gave the fox a tail, then made it bow. Kit laughed, surprising himself. When Mira offered him the lantern, he took it with both hands. “I can carry the sun,” he said, though he kept close to her sleeve.

Kit remembered placing Pip under the rainfly, but something bothered him. He had worn his jacket while helping Mira gather pinecones near the fern hollow. He patted the pocket that had carried the toy. “Maybe he fell out there,” he said. “Or maybe I just want him to be there.” Mira could hear the uncertainty in his voice. She let him finish.

Dad came over with a handful of orange reflector tabs. He clipped them along the guyline that ran from the tent toward the fern hollow. “These catch the lantern light,” he said. “If you lose sight of camp, follow them back. I’ll keep the fire going.” He did not offer to search for them. He knew Kit needed to try, and Mira needed to lead without pretending she knew everything.

Mira counted two bright bars on the lantern’s battery display. One careful sweep at Kit’s remembered spot would leave one bar. If Pip was not there, they could turn back, or spend the last bar searching the fern hollow and return by the reflectors. The second way might work. It also meant trusting the path once the lantern went dark.

They walked to the tent edge first. Mira swept the beam beneath the rainfly and across the bedrolls. Kit lifted a corner of canvas. There was a pinecone, a mitten, and a crumb of toast, but no fox. Kit’s shoulders folded in. “I did put him here,” he said. “I believe you,” Mira answered. “I just don’t think he stayed.”

The lantern showed one bar. Mira could turn around now and keep the light for the walk back. She could also use it to search the fern hollow, where Kit’s jacket had brushed the branches. “If we go farther, we’ll come back by Dad’s reflectors,” she said. “No guessing once the light is gone.” Kit looked down the path. “I want to look. I can help.”

Mira handed him the lantern. It was his turn to choose where the beam landed. Kit walked slowly past the guyline tabs, and Mira held his free hand where the wet roots crossed the path. At the fern hollow he searched the branches while Mira checked the ground. The lantern lit a corner of bright cloth beneath a curled leaf.

“Pip!” Kit dropped to his knees. The fox was caught beneath a flap of rainfly that had blown loose from the tent, its stitched smile muddy but familiar. Kit pulled him free and hugged him against his chest. Mira’s knees were damp. Neither of them cared. The lantern’s final bar blinked once, then faded.

For a moment the woods seemed very large again. Then Kit spotted a reflector wink ahead. They followed the orange points, hand in hand, until the firelight found their faces. Kit was still nervous, but he was no longer hiding behind Mira. He had carried the light, and he had helped find the way back.

Dad took the lantern from Mira. “Pip’s back,” she said. “And the lantern got us home.” Dad nodded and set it beside the cooking pot; it had done its important work. Kit wiped the fox with a clean corner of his blanket. “He’s muddy,” he said, “but so are you.” Mira looked at her knees. “Then we match.”

At supper, Kit placed Pip on the empty chair between them. Mira told Dad where they had searched and why they had turned back by the reflectors. Dad listened without interrupting. When he asked who had led the way, Kit raised the lantern’s dark handle. “We did,” he said. Mira liked that answer better than being called brave by herself.

Later, Kit tucked Pip beside his pillow and asked Mira to leave the tent flap open a finger’s width. She did. Their shadows on the canvas were small again, moving whenever the fire shifted. Kit watched them without shrinking. Mira had wanted to prove she could lead; she had learned that leading meant leaving room for someone else to carry the light."},{"path":"storyscenes/mini_adventures/kite/scene_inventory.json","content":"{

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
import json
import random
from pathlib import Path

from storyscenes.runtime import StoryError
from storyscenes.mini_adventures.local_play import LocalPlay
from .prose import render

SITES = ('tent_edge', 'fern_hollow')
SCENES = (
    'borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox', 'shadow_vignette', 'trail_vignette',
    'choose_search', 'search_fox', 'return_to_camp', 'ending_found', 'ending_lost',
)
OPTIONAL = frozenset(('shadow_vignette', 'trail_vignette'))


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Parameters:
    toy_site: str = 'fern_hollow'
    kit_memory: str = 'tent_edge'
    daylight_minutes: int = 2
    lantern_charge: int = 2
    toy_covered: bool = True
    ground_wet: bool = False
    search_policy: str = 'sweep'

    def __post_init__(self):
        if type(self.toy_site) is not str or self.toy_site not in SITES:
            raise ValueError('toy_site must be tent_edge or fern_hollow')
        if type(self.kit_memory) is not str or self.kit_memory not in SITES:
            raise ValueError('kit_memory must be tent_edge or fern_hollow')
        if type(self.daylight_minutes) is not int or not 0 <= self.daylight_minutes <= 2:
            raise ValueError('daylight_minutes must be an integer from 0 to 2')
        if type(self.lantern_charge) is not int or not 1 <= self.lantern_charge <= 3:
            raise ValueError('lantern_charge must be an integer from 1 to 3')
        if type(self.toy_covered) is not bool or type(self.ground_wet) is not bool:
            raise ValueError('toy_covered and ground_wet must be booleans')
        if type(self.search_policy) is not str or self.search_policy not in ('conserve', 'sweep'):
            raise ValueError('search_policy must be conserve or sweep')


def parameters(seed):
    if type(seed) is not int:
        raise ValueError('seed must be an integer')
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    return Parameters(
        toy_site=rng.choice(SITES),
        kit_memory=rng.choice(SITES),
        daylight_minutes=rng.choice((0, 1, 2)),
        lantern_charge=rng.choice((1, 2, 3)),
        toy_covered=rng.choice((True, False)),
        ground_wet=rng.choice((True, False)),
        search_policy=rng.choice(('conserve', 'sweep')),
    )


def initial(params):
    if not isinstance(params, Parameters):
        raise TypeError('params must be a Parameters instance')
    return {
        'story.ended': False, 'story.outcome': '',
        'camp.location': 'camp', 'mira.location': 'camp', 'kit.location': 'camp',
        'dad.location': 'camp',
        'mira.goal': 'help_kit_and_return_lantern', 'mira.promise': False,
        'mira.search_policy': params.search_policy, 'mira.search_choice_made': False,
        'mira.boots_muddy': False,
        'kit.goal': 'find_pip', 'kit.fear': 0, 'kit.courage': 0,
        'kit.memory_site': params.kit_memory, 'kit.remembers_site': False,
        'kit.hand_in_mira': False, 'kit.boots_muddy': False,
        'kit.has_fox': False, 'kit.comfort': 'none', 'kit.accepted_loss': False,
        'dad.goal': 'keep_children_safe_and_cook_supper', 'dad.used_lantern': False,
        'lantern.owner': 'dad', 'lantern.holder': 'none', 'lantern.location': 'camp_table',
        'lantern.borrowed': False, 'lantern.returned': False, 'lantern.lit': False,
        'lantern.charge': params.lantern_charge, 'lantern.initial_charge': params.lantern_charge,
        'lantern.used_to_search': False, 'lantern.used_to_guide': False,
        'fox.owner': 'kit', 'fox.initial_site': params.toy_site, 'fox.location': params.toy_site,
        'fox.covered_initial': params.toy_covered, 'fox.covered': params.toy_covered,
        'fox.recovered': False,
        'search.started': False, 'search.complete': False, 'search.found': False,
        'search.first_checked': False, 'search.first_area': '', 'search.second_checked': False,
        'search.stop_reason': '',
        'sky.initial_minutes': params.daylight_minutes, 'sky.minutes_left': params.daylight_minutes,
        'ground.wet': params.ground_wet,
        'shadow.played': False, 'trail.lesson': False, 'trail.marked': False,
        'trail.marker_used': False,
        'return.safe': False, 'return.path': '',
    }


_STATE_KEYS = frozenset(initial(Parameters()).keys())
_BOOL_KEYS = frozenset((
    'story.ended', 'mira.promise', 'mira.search_choice_made', 'mira.boots_muddy',
    'kit.remembers_site', 'kit.hand_in_mira', 'kit.boots_muddy', 'kit.has_fox',
    'kit.accepted_loss', 'dad.used_lantern', 'lantern.borrowed', 'lantern.returned',
    'lantern.lit', 'lantern.used_to_search', 'lantern.used_to_guide',
    'fox.covered_initial', 'fox.covered', 'fox.recovered', 'search.started',
    'search.complete', 'search.found', 'search.first_checked', 'search.second_checked',
    'ground.wet', 'shadow.played', 'trail.lesson', 'trail.marked', 'trail.marker_used',
    'return.safe',
))
_STRING_KEYS = _STATE_KEYS - _BOOL_KEYS - frozenset((
    'kit.fear', 'kit.courage', 'lantern.charge', 'lantern.initial_charge',
    'sky.initial_minutes', 'sky.minutes_left',
))


def validate(state):
    if not isinstance(state, dict) or set(state) != _STATE_KEYS:
        raise StoryError('State keys do not match this world')
    for key in _BOOL_KEYS:
        if type(state[key]) is not bool:
            raise StoryError(f'{key} must be boolean')
    for key in ('kit.fear', 'kit.courage', 'lantern.charge', 'lantern.initial_charge',
                'sky.initial_minutes', 'sky.minutes_left'):
        if type(state[key]) is not int:
            raise StoryError(f'{key} must be an integer')
    for key in _STRING_KEYS:
        if type(state[key]) is not str:
            raise StoryError(f'{key} must be a string')
    if state['camp.location'] not in ('camp', *SITES):
        raise StoryError('Unknown campsite location')
    if not (state['mira.location'] == state['kit.location'] == state['camp.location']):
        raise StoryError('The siblings must travel together')
    if state['dad.location'] != 'camp':
        raise StoryError('Dad remains at the family campsite')
    if state['mira.goal'] != 'help_kit_and_return_lantern' or state['kit.goal'] != 'find_pip':
        raise StoryError('Character motives changed unexpectedly')
    if state['dad.goal'] != 'keep_children_safe_and_cook_supper' or state['fox.owner'] != 'kit':
        raise StoryError('Character or toy identity changed unexpectedly')
    if state['fox.initial_site'] not in SITES or state['kit.memory_site'] not in SITES:
        raise StoryError('Invalid remembered or actual toy site')
    if state['mira.search_policy'] not in ('conserve', 'sweep'):
        raise StoryError('Invalid search policy')
    if not 1 <= state['lantern.initial_charge'] <= 3:
        raise StoryError('Invalid initial lantern charge')
    if not 0 <= state['lantern.charge'] <= state['lantern.initial_charge']:
        raise StoryError('Lantern charge cannot be created or negative')
    if not 0 <= state['sky.minutes_left'] <= state['sky.initial_minutes'] <= 2:
        raise StoryError('Daylight cannot increase')
    if not 0 <= state['kit.fear'] <= 2 or state['kit.courage'] not in (0, 1):
        raise StoryError('Invalid emotional state')
    if not state['fox.covered_initial'] and state['fox.covered']:
        raise StoryError('A toy cannot become covered after the search begins')
    if state['fox.location'] not in (*SITES, 'kit_hand', 'kit_bedroll'):
        raise StoryError('Unknown toy location')
    if state['fox.recovered'] != (state['fox.location'] in ('kit_hand', 'kit_bedroll')):
        raise StoryError('Toy location and recovery disagree')
    if state['kit.has_fox'] != (state['fox.location'] == 'kit_bedroll'):
        raise StoryError('Kit and toy locations disagree')
    if state['fox.recovered'] and state['fox.covered']:
        raise StoryError('A covered toy cannot already be recovered')
    if state['lantern.owner'] != 'dad':
        raise StoryError('The borrowed lantern remains Dad’s property')
    holder_location = {'none': 'camp_table', 'mira': 'mira_hand', 'kit': 'kit_hand', 'dad': 'dad_hand'}
    if state['lantern.holder'] not in holder_location or state['lantern.location'] != holder_location[state['lantern.holder']]:
        raise StoryError('Lantern holder and location disagree')
    if state['lantern.borrowed']:
        if state['lantern.returned'] or state['lantern.holder'] not in ('mira', 'kit'):
            raise StoryError('Borrowed lantern is not with a sibling')
    elif state['lantern.returned']:
        if state['lantern.holder'] != 'dad':
            raise StoryError('Returned lantern must be with Dad')
    elif state['lantern.holder'] != 'none':
        raise StoryError('Unborrowed lantern must remain on the camp table')
    if state['lantern.lit'] and state['lantern.charge'] <= 0:
        raise StoryError('An empty lantern cannot be lit')
    if (state['lantern.borrowed'] or state['lantern.returned']) and not state['mira.promise']:
        raise StoryError('The borrowing promise must be enacted')
    if state['shadow.played'] != (state['kit.courage'] == 1):
        raise StoryError('The shadow vignette and earned courage disagree')
    if state['trail.marker_used'] and not state['trail.marked']:
        raise StoryError('Unplaced reflectors cannot guide the return')
    if state['mira.search_choice_made'] != state['search.started']:
        raise StoryError('Search choice and search state disagree')
    if state['search.first_area'] not in ('', *SITES):
        raise StoryError('Unknown first search area')
    if state['search.second_checked'] and not state['search.first_checked']:
        raise StoryError('A second search requires a first search')
    if state['search.complete'] and not (state['search.started'] and state['search.first_checked']):
        raise StoryError('Search completion lacks an enacted search')
    if state['search.found'] != state['fox.recovered']:
        raise StoryError('Search result and toy recovery disagree')
    if state['search.stop_reason'] not in ('', 'found_first', 'found_second', 'conserve', 'low_light'):
        raise StoryError('Unknown search outcome')
    if state['search.complete']:
        if state['search.found'] and state['search.stop_reason'] not in ('found_first', 'found_second'):
            raise StoryError('Found search lacks its enacted result')
        if not state['search.found'] and state['search.stop_reason'] not in ('conserve', 'low_light'):
            raise StoryError('Unsuccessful search lacks a stopping reason')
    if state['kit.comfort'] not in ('none', 'blue_camp_blanket'):
        raise StoryError('Unknown comfort item')
    if state['kit.accepted_loss'] != (state['kit.comfort'] == 'blue_camp_blanket'):
        raise StoryError('Comfort and acceptance disagree')
    if state['return.path'] not in ('', 'lantern', 'reflectors', 'daylight', 'campfire'):
        raise StoryError('Unknown return route')
    if state['return.safe'] != (state['return.path'] != ''):
        raise StoryError('Return route and safety state disagree')
    if state['return.safe'] and (state['camp.location'] != 'camp' or not state['search.complete']):
        raise StoryError('Safe return requires a completed search at camp')
    if state['return.path'] == 'reflectors' and not state['trail.marker_used']:
        raise StoryError('Reflector route was not established')
    if state['return.path'] == 'lantern' and not state['lantern.used_to_guide']:
        raise StoryError('Lantern route was not enacted')
    if state['dad.used_lantern'] and not (state['lantern.returned'] and state['lantern.lit']):
        raise StoryError('Dad can use the lantern only after it is returned and lit')
    if state['story.ended'] != (state['story.outcome'] != ''):
        raise StoryError('Ended state and outcome disagree')
    if state['story.outcome'] not in ('', 'fox_recovered', 'comforted_with_fox_missing'):
        raise StoryError('Unknown ending')
    if state['story.ended']:
        if not (state['return.safe'] and state['camp.location'] == 'camp' and state['lantern.returned']):
            raise StoryError('Ending leaves the family or borrowed lantern unfinished')
        if state['story.outcome'] == 'fox_recovered':
            if not state['kit.has_fox'] or state['kit.accepted_loss']:
                raise StoryError('Success ending does not match the toy state')
        elif state['fox.recovered'] or not state['kit.accepted_loss']:
            raise StoryError('Comfort ending does not match the toy state')
    return None


def _check_params_state(params, state):
    expected = (
        ('fox.initial_site', params.toy_site), ('kit.memory_site', params.kit_memory),
        ('sky.initial_minutes', params.daylight_minutes),
        ('lantern.initial_charge', params.lantern_charge),
        ('fox.covered_initial', params.toy_covered), ('ground.wet', params.ground_wet),
        ('mira.search_policy', params.search_policy),
    )
    if any(state[key] != value for key, value in expected):
        raise StoryError('Parameters do not describe this state')


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Episode:
    id: str
    before: dict
    after: dict
    events: tuple[dict, ...]
    text: str


def guard(scene_id, state):
    validate(state)
    if scene_id not in SCENES:
        raise StoryError(f'Unknown scene: {scene_id}')
    if state['story.ended']:
        return False
    at_camp = state['camp.location'] == 'camp'
    if scene_id == 'borrow_lantern':
        return at_camp and not state['lantern.borrowed'] and not state['mira.promise']
    if scene_id == 'tell_about_fox':
        return at_camp and state['lantern.borrowed'] and not state['kit.remembers_site']
    if scene_id in ('shadow_vignette', 'trail_vignette'):
        if not (at_camp and state['kit.remembers_site'] and not state['search.started']):
            return False
        if scene_id == 'shadow_vignette':
            return not state['shadow.played']
        return not state['trail.lesson']
    if scene_id == 'choose_search':
        return at_camp and state['kit.remembers_site'] and not state['search.started']
    if scene_id == 'search_fox':
        return state['search.started'] and not state['search.complete'] and state['camp.location'] in SITES
    if scene_id == 'return_to_camp':
        return state['search.complete'] and not state['return.safe'] and state['camp.location'] in SITES
    if scene_id == 'ending_found':
        return state['return.safe'] and at_camp and state['search.found'] and not state['story.ended']
    if scene_id == 'ending_lost':
        return state['return.safe'] and at_camp and not state['search.found'] and not state['story.ended']
    return False


def _recover_fox(play, result):
    site = play.state['camp.location']
    if play.state['fox.covered']:
        play.act('lift_cover_from_fox', requires={'fox.location': site, 'fox.covered': True},
                 **{'fox.covered': False})
    play.act('pick_up_pip', requires={'fox.location': site, 'search.complete': False},
             **{'fox.location': 'kit_hand', 'fox.recovered': True, 'search.found': True,
                'search.complete': True, 'search.stop_reason': result})


def _return_lantern(play):
    play.act('return_lantern_to_dad', requires={'lantern.borrowed': True, 'return.safe': True},
             **{'lantern.borrowed': False, 'lantern.returned': True,
                'lantern.holder': 'dad', 'lantern.location': 'dad_hand'})
    if play.state['lantern.charge'] > 0:
        play.act('dad_lights_supper', requires={'lantern.returned': True, 'lantern.lit': False},
                 **{'lantern.lit': True, 'dad.used_lantern': True})


def play_scene(params, state, scene_id):
    if not isinstance(params, Parameters):
        raise TypeError('params must be a Parameters instance')
    validate(state)
    _check_params_state(params, state)
    if not guard(scene_id, state):
        raise StoryError(f'Scene not compatible with current state: {scene_id}')
    before = deepcopy(state)
    play = LocalPlay(state, actors=('Mira', 'Kit'), validate=validate)

    if scene_id == 'borrow_lantern':
        play.act('dad_lends_lantern', requires={'lantern.owner': 'dad', 'lantern.borrowed': False},
                 **{'lantern.borrowed': True, 'lantern.holder': 'mira', 'lantern.location': 'mira_hand'})
        play.act('promise_to_return_lantern', requires={'lantern.borrowed': True},
                 **{'mira.promise': True})
        play.act('switch_on_lantern', requires={'lantern.charge': play.state['lantern.charge']},
                 **{'lantern.lit': True})
    elif scene_id == 'tell_about_fox':
        play.act('kit_reveals_missing_fox', requires={'lantern.borrowed': True},
                 **{'kit.remembers_site': True, 'kit.fear': 2})
    elif scene_id == 'shadow_vignette':
        play.act('make_fox_shadow_together', requires={'lantern.lit': True, 'kit.fear': 2},
                 **{'shadow.played': True, 'kit.courage': 1, 'kit.fear': 1})
        play.act('kit_takes_the_lantern', requires={'lantern.holder': 'mira'},
                 **{'lantern.holder': 'kit', 'lantern.location': 'kit_hand'})
    elif scene_id == 'trail_vignette':
        play.act('dad_clips_reflectors_to_guyline', requires={'dad.location': 'camp'},
                 **{'trail.lesson': True, 'trail.marked': True})
    elif scene_id == 'choose_search':
        play.act('mira_agrees_search_policy', requires={'mira.search_choice_made': False},
                 **{'mira.search_choice_made': True})
        if not play.state['lantern.lit']:
            play.act('relight_for_search', requires={'lantern.charge': play.state['lantern.charge']},
                     **{'lantern.lit': True})
        site = play.state['kit.memory_site']
        changes = {
            'camp.location': site, 'mira.location': site, 'kit.location': site,
            'search.started': True, 'search.first_area': site,
        }
        action = 'walk_to_tent_edge' if site == 'tent_edge' else 'walk_to_fern_hollow'
        if site == 'fern_hollow' and play.state['ground.wet']:
            changes.update({'mira.boots_muddy': True, 'kit.boots_muddy': True, 'kit.hand_in_mira': True})
            action = 'hold_hands_on_wet_roots'
        play.act(action, requires={'kit.remembers_site': True, 'mira.search_choice_made': True},
                 **changes)
    elif scene_id == 'search_fox':
        charge = play.state['lantern.charge']
        minutes = play.state['sky.minutes_left']
        play.act('sweep_remembered_site',
                 requires={'search.started': True, 'lantern.lit': True, 'lantern.charge': charge},
                 **{'lantern.charge': charge - 1, 'lantern.lit': False,
                    'lantern.used_to_search': True, 'sky.minutes_left': max(0, minutes - 1),
                    'search.first_checked': True})
        if play.state['camp.location'] == play.state['fox.location']:
            _recover_fox(play, 'found_first')
        else:
            policy = play.state['mira.search_policy']
            charge_left = play.state['lantern.charge']
            minutes_left = play.state['sky.minutes_left']
            if policy == 'sweep' and (charge_left > 0 or minutes_left > 0):
                second_site = 'fern_hollow' if play.state['camp.location'] == 'tent_edge' else 'tent_edge'
                changes = {'camp.location': second_site, 'mira.location': second_site,
                           'kit.location': second_site}
                if second_site == 'fern_hollow' and play.state['ground.wet']:
                    changes.update({'mira.boots_muddy': True, 'kit.boots_muddy': True,
                                    'kit.hand_in_mira': True})
                    move_action = 'cross_wet_roots_together'
                else:
                    move_action = 'check_the_other_site'
                play.act(move_action, requires={'search.first_checked': True}, **changes)
                if play.state['lantern.charge'] > 0:
                    if not play.state['lantern.lit']:
                        play.act('relight_for_second_sweep',
                                 requires={'lantern.charge': play.state['lantern.charge']},
                                 **{'lantern.lit': True})
                    charge = play.state['lantern.charge']
                    minutes = play.state['sky.minutes_left']
                    play.act('spend_second_lantern_sweep',
                             requires={'lantern.lit': True, 'lantern.charge': charge},
                             **{'lantern.charge': charge - 1, 'lantern.lit': False,
                                'lantern.used_to_search': True,
                                'sky.minutes_left': max(0, minutes - 1),
                                'search.second_checked': True})
                else:
                    minutes = play.state['sky.minutes_left']
                    play.act('search_in_last_daylight',
                             requires={'sky.minutes_left': minutes},
                             **{'sky.minutes_left': minutes - 1, 'search.second_checked': True})
                if play.state['camp.location'] == play.state['fox.location']:
                    _recover_fox(play, 'found_second')
                else:
                    play.act('stop_after_empty_sweep', requires={'search.second_checked': True},
                             **{'search.complete': True, 'search.stop_reason': 'low_light'})
            else:
                reason = 'conserve' if policy == 'conserve' else 'low_light'
                action = 'turn_back_by_agreement' if reason == 'conserve' else 'stop_when_light_runs_out'
                play.act(action, requires={'search.first_checked': True},
                         **{'search.complete': True, 'search.stop_reason': reason})
    elif scene_id == 'return_to_camp':
        if play.state['lantern.charge'] > 0:
            if not play.state['lantern.lit']:
                play.act('switch_lantern_on_for_return',
                         requires={'lantern.charge': play.state['lantern.charge']},
                         **{'lantern.lit': True})
            charge = play.state['lantern.charge']
            fear = play.state['kit.fear']
            play.act('follow_lantern_beam_home',
                     requires={'lantern.lit': True, 'lantern.charge': charge},
                     **{'lantern.charge': charge - 1, 'lantern.lit': False,
                        'lantern.used_to_guide': True, 'camp.location': 'camp',
                        'mira.location': 'camp', 'kit.location': 'camp',
                        'kit.fear': max(0, fear - 1), 'kit.hand_in_mira': False,
                        'return.safe': True, 'return.path': 'lantern'})
        else:
            fear = play.state['kit.fear']
            if play.state['trail.marked']:
                path = 'reflectors'
                action = 'follow_dads_reflector_tabs'
                extra = {'trail.marker_used': True}
            elif play.state['sky.minutes_left'] > 0:
                path = 'daylight'
                action = 'backtrack_while_the_path_is_visible'
                extra = {}
            else:
                path = 'campfire'
                action = 'follow_the_glow_of_camp'
                extra = {}
            changes = {
                'camp.location': 'camp', 'mira.location': 'camp', 'kit.location': 'camp',
                'kit.fear': max(0, fear - 1), 'kit.hand_in_mira': False,
                'return.safe': True, 'return.path': path,
            }
            changes.update(extra)
            play.act(action, requires={'search.complete': True, 'lantern.charge': 0}, **changes)
    elif scene_id == 'ending_found':
        play.act('settle_pip_beside_kit', requires={'fox.location': 'kit_hand'},
                 **{'fox.location': 'kit_bedroll', 'kit.has_fox': True, 'kit.fear': 0})
        _return_lantern(play)
        play.act('finish_with_pip_home', requires={'kit.has_fox': True, 'lantern.returned': True},
                 **{'story.ended': True, 'story.outcome': 'fox_recovered'})
    elif scene_id == 'ending_lost':
        play.act('offer_kit_the_blue_blanket', requires={'fox.recovered': False},
                 **{'kit.comfort': 'blue_camp_blanket', 'kit.accepted_loss': True, 'kit.fear': 0})
        _return_lantern(play)
        play.act('finish_with_siblings_together', requires={'kit.accepted_loss': True, 'lantern.returned': True},
                 **{'story.ended': True, 'story.outcome': 'comforted_with_fox_missing'})

    after = deepcopy(play.state)
    validate(after)
    text = render(scene_id, params, before, after)
    return Episode(id=scene_id, before=before, after=after,
                   events=tuple(deepcopy(play.events)), text=text)


def _episode_json(episode):
    return {
        'id': episode.id, 'before': deepcopy(episode.before), 'after': deepcopy(episode.after),
        'events': deepcopy(list(episode.events)), 'text': episode.text,
    }


def replay(params, path):
    if not isinstance(params, Parameters):
        raise TypeError('params must be a Parameters instance')
    if not isinstance(path, (tuple, list)):
        raise TypeError('path must be a list or tuple of scene IDs')
    state = initial(params)
    episodes = []
    used = set()
    for scene_id in path:
        if scene_id in used:
            raise StoryError('A scene cannot be repeated in this scenario')
        episode = play_scene(params, state, scene_id)
        episodes.append(episode)
        state = episode.after
        used.add(scene_id)
    return tuple(episodes)


def generate(seed=0, *, count=8, params=None):
    if type(seed) is not int:
        raise ValueError('seed must be an integer')
    if type(count) is not int or count not in (7, 8):
        raise ValueError('count must be exactly 7 or 8')
    chosen = parameters(seed) if params is None else params
    if not isinstance(chosen, Parameters):
        raise TypeError('params must be a Parameters instance')
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    attempts = 0

    def visit(state, episodes, used):
        nonlocal attempts
        remaining = count - len(episodes)
        if remaining == 0:
            return episodes if state['story.ended'] else None
        choices = [scene_id for scene_id in SCENES
                   if scene_id not in used and guard(scene_id, state)
                   and (not scene_id.startswith('ending_') or remaining == 1)]
        rng.shuffle(choices)
        for scene_id in choices:
            attempts += 1
            if attempts > 10000:
                raise StoryError('Bounded scene search exhausted its 10000-attempt budget')
            episode = play_scene(chosen, state, scene_id)
            result = visit(episode.after, episodes + (episode,), used | {scene_id})
            if result is not None:
                return result
        return None

    result = visit(initial(chosen), (), frozenset())
    if result is None:
        raise StoryError('No compatible route reaches an ending at this scene count')
    final_state = deepcopy(result[-1].after)
    rows = [_episode_json(episode) for episode in result]
    return {
        'seed': seed,
        'parameters': asdict(chosen),
        'scene_count': count,
        'path': [episode.id for episode in result],
        'story': '\n\n'.join(episode.text for episode in result),
        'episodes': rows,
        'final_state': final_state,
        'search_attempts': attempts,
    }


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--seed', type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument('--scenes', type=int, choices=(7, 8), default=8)
    parser.add_argument('--params', type=Path, help='JSON file of Parameters overrides')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    chosen = parameters(args.seed)
    if args.params:
        overrides = json.loads(args.params.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if not isinstance(overrides, dict):
            parser.error('--params must contain a JSON object')
        chosen = Parameters(**(asdict(chosen) | overrides))
    row = generate(args.seed, count=args.scenes, params=chosen)
    print(row['story'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def _site(site):
    return 'the tent edge' if site == 'tent_edge' else 'the fern hollow'


def render(scene_id, params, before, after):
    if scene_id == 'borrow_lantern':
        return ('The tent flap snapped while Kit searched under the bedrolls. Dad passed Mira the battery lantern, already glowing. '
                '“Borrow it, but bring it back before supper,” he said. Mira promised. Kit stayed close enough to touch her sleeve; '
                'the shadows between the tents were stretching longer.')
    if scene_id == 'tell_about_fox':
        return (f'“Pip is gone,” Kit whispered. He remembered { _site(after["kit.memory_site"]) }, though he was not sure. '
                'The trees beyond camp looked taller than they had at lunch. Mira could have called the fox only a toy. '
                'Instead, she waited for Kit to finish explaining and said, “We will look together.”')
    if scene_id == 'shadow_vignette':
        return ('On the tent wall, Mira made two ears with her fingers. “That is Pip,” Kit decided, stretching the shadow into a fox. '
                'His laugh came out shaky, then steadier. Mira offered him the lantern. He took it with both hands. '
                '“I can carry the sun,” he said, and stayed beside her.')
    if scene_id == 'trail_vignette':
        return ('Dad clipped orange reflector tabs along the guyline toward the fern hollow. “They catch the lantern light,” he said. '
                '“If you lose sight of camp, follow these back. I will keep the fire going.” Kit touched one bright tab. '
                'Mira understood that the path home was something they could prepare, not just hope for.')
    if scene_id == 'choose_search':
        place = _site(after['camp.location'])
        carrier = 'Kit' if after['lantern.holder'] == 'kit' else 'Mira'
        if after['mira.search_policy'] == 'sweep':
            plan = 'If this is empty, we can spend what remains on one more sweep.'
        else:
            plan = 'We will make one careful search, then turn back rather than wander.'
        if after['kit.hand_in_mira']:
            footing = 'Wet roots crossed the path, so Mira and Kit held hands and stepped slowly.'
        elif after['camp.location'] == 'fern_hollow':
            footing = 'They took the narrow path between the ferns, watching where they placed their boots.'
        else:
            footing = 'They stopped by the tent edge, where the bedrolls and rainfly were easy to inspect.'
        return (f'{carrier} carried the lantern as they followed Kit’s memory to {place}. Mira explained their choice: '
                f'“{plan}” {footing} Kit nodded; he had helped choose the search, not just follow it.')
    if scene_id == 'search_fox':
        if after['search.found']:
            if after['search.stop_reason'] == 'found_first':
                found_line = f'The beam found Pip at { _site(after["camp.location"]) }, where Kit had remembered him.'
            else:
                found_line = (f'The first place was empty, so they used the next sweep at { _site(after["camp.location"]) }. '
                              'There the beam caught Pip.')
            if before['fox.covered']:
                cover_line = 'Mira lifted the curled rainfly, and Kit pulled the soft fox free.'
            else:
                cover_line = 'Kit reached down and lifted the soft fox from the open ground.'
            return (f'{found_line} {cover_line} “Pip!” Kit hugged him against his coat. '
                    'The lantern had spent another bar, but the fox was warm in Kit’s arms. Mira checked that they still knew the way back.')
        if after['search.stop_reason'] == 'conserve':
            return (f'The beam swept { _site(after["search.first_area"]) }, but found only a pinecone and a mitten. '
                    'Mira kept the agreement they had made: one careful look, then back together. Kit swallowed his disappointment. '
                    '“I thought I knew,” he said. “You remembered what you could,” Mira answered.')
        return (f'The lantern swept { _site(after["search.first_area"]) }, but Pip was not there. They checked the other place only after the last light or daylight allowed it; '
                'neither search found him. Mira called the search off. Kit was sad, but he held her hand instead of staring into the trees.')
    if scene_id == 'return_to_camp':
        if after['return.path'] == 'lantern':
            route = 'Mira switched the lantern on and carried its beam along the path. It used another bar, but kept Kit close and showed each turn.'
        elif after['return.path'] == 'reflectors':
            route = 'The lantern had gone dark, so they followed Dad’s orange reflector tabs back along the guyline.'
        elif after['return.path'] == 'daylight':
            route = 'With the last daylight still visible, they retraced the path they had walked together.'
        else:
            route = 'The lantern was empty; they turned toward the familiar orange glow of their family fire.'
        muddy = ' Mud clung to both pairs of boots.' if after['mira.boots_muddy'] else ''
        return (f'{route}{muddy} Kit still felt a little nervous, but the path no longer belonged to the dark alone. '
                'The tent and the fire came into view. They had returned together, with the borrowed lantern still in hand.')
    if scene_id == 'ending_found':
        muddy = ' Their boots left muddy marks beside the bedroll.' if before['mira.boots_muddy'] else ''
        dad = ('Dad used the remaining lantern light beside the supper pot.' if after['dad.used_lantern']
               else 'Dad took the dark lantern back and set it beside the cooking pot.')
        return (f'Kit settled Pip beside his bedroll and wiped the fox’s muddy ear on a blanket.{muddy} '
                '“I was scared,” he said, “but I carried the light.” Mira smiled; she had not needed to search alone to lead. '
                f'{dad} The fox was home, and the siblings sat down to supper together.')
    if scene_id == 'ending_lost':
        place = _site(after['fox.location'])
        dad = ('Dad used the remaining lantern light beside the supper pot.' if after['dad.used_lantern']
               else 'Dad took the dark lantern back and set it beside the cooking pot.')
        muddy = ' Mira’s knees were muddy, and Kit noticed.' if before['mira.boots_muddy'] else ''
        return (f'Pip remained out at {place}. Kit accepted the blue camp blanket and let himself be sad without being alone.{muddy} '
                '“I am still scared of the trees,” he said, “but not of being here with you.” Mira returned the lantern to Dad. '
                f'{dad} They ate supper beside the fire, together.')
    raise ValueError(f'No prose for scene: {scene_id}')

def episode_json(episode):

class KiteWorldTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def verify_row(self, row):
        params = Parameters(**row['parameters'])
        episodes = replay(params, row['path'])
        self.assertEqual([episode_json(e) for e in episodes], row['episodes'])
        self.assertEqual(episodes[-1].after, row['final_state'])
        self.assertEqual('\n\n'.join(e.text for e in episodes), row['story'])
        self.assertEqual(len(row['path']), row['scene_count'])
        self.assertEqual(len(set(row['path'])), len(row['path']))
        self.assertTrue(row['final_state']['story.ended'])
        self.assertTrue(row['final_state']['story.outcome'])

        for episode in episodes:
            self.assertEqual(episode.before, state)
            self.assertTrue(guard(episode.id, state))
            self.assertTrue(episode.events)
            for event in episode.events:
                self.assertTrue(event['action'])
                self.assertTrue(event['changes'])
                for key, value in event['requires'].items():
                    self.assertEqual(state[key], value)
                for key, change in event['changes'].items():
                    self.assertEqual(state[key], change['before'])

                    state[key] = deepcopy(change['after'])

    def test_optional_vignettes_have_no_offstage_effects(self):

        base = replay(params, ('borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox'))[-1].after
        self.assertFalse(base['shadow.played'])
        self.assertFalse(base['trail.marked'])
        no_shadow = replay(params, ('borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox', 'trail_vignette'))[-1].after
        self.assertFalse(no_shadow['shadow.played'])
        self.assertTrue(no_shadow['trail.marked'])
        no_trail = replay(params, ('borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox', 'shadow_vignette'))[-1].after
        self.assertTrue(no_trail['shadow.played'])
        self.assertFalse(no_trail['trail.marked'])
        for omitted_path in (
            ('borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox', 'choose_search', 'search_fox', 'return_to_camp', 'ending_found'),
            ('borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox', 'shadow_vignette', 'choose_search', 'search_fox', 'return_to_camp', 'ending_found'),
            ('borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox', 'trail_vignette', 'choose_search', 'search_fox', 'return_to_camp', 'ending_found'),

            self.assertFalse(final['shadow.played'] if 'shadow_vignette' not in omitted_path else False)
            self.assertFalse(final['trail.marked'] if 'trail_vignette' not in omitted_path else False)

        self.assertEqual(light_row['final_state']['story.outcome'], 'fox_recovered')
        conserve = Parameters(**(base | {'lantern_charge': 2, 'search_policy': 'conserve'}))
        sweep = Parameters(**(base | {'lantern_charge': 2, 'search_policy': 'sweep'}))
        self.assertEqual(generate(9, params=conserve)['final_state']['story.outcome'], 'comforted_with_fox_missing')
        self.assertEqual(generate(9, params=sweep)['final_state']['story.outcome'], 'fox_recovered')

        for covered in (False, True):

                                search_policy='conserve')
            episodes = replay(params, ('borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox', 'choose_search', 'search_fox'))
            actions = [event['action'] for event in episodes[-1].events]
            self.assertEqual('lift_cover_from_fox' in actions, covered)
            self.assertEqual(episodes[-1].after['fox.location'], 'kit_hand')

    def test_locations_and_borrowed_object_remain_continuous(self):
        for count in (7, 8):
            row = generate(37, count=count)
            params = Parameters(**row['parameters'])
            state = initial(params)
            for episode in replay(params, row['path']):
                for key in ('camp.location', 'mira.location', 'kit.location'):
                    self.assertEqual(state['camp.location'], state[key])
                self.assertEqual(state['lantern.owner'], 'dad')
                expected_lantern_location = {
                    'none': 'camp_table', 'mira': 'mira_hand', 'kit': 'kit_hand', 'dad': 'dad_hand'
                }[state['lantern.holder']]
                self.assertEqual(state['lantern.location'], expected_lantern_location)
                if state['fox.recovered']:
                    self.assertIn(state['fox.location'], ('kit_hand', 'kit_bedroll'))
                else:
                    self.assertIn(state['fox.location'], ('tent_edge', 'fern_hollow'))

    def test_endings_require_their_actual_middle(self):
        for params, ending in (
            (Parameters(toy_site='fern_hollow', kit_memory='fern_hollow', lantern_charge=1,
                        daylight_minutes=0, search_policy='conserve'), 'ending_found'),
            (Parameters(toy_site='fern_hollow', kit_memory='tent_edge', lantern_charge=1,
                        daylight_minutes=0, search_policy='sweep'), 'ending_lost'),
        ):
            state = initial(params)
            for scene_id in ('borrow_lantern', 'tell_about_fox', 'choose_search', 'search_fox', 'return_to_camp'):
                state = play_scene(params, state, scene_id).after
            self.assertTrue(guard(ending, state))
            other = 'ending_lost' if ending == 'ending_found' else 'ending_found'
            self.assertFalse(guard(other, state))
            final = play_scene(params, state, ending).after
            self.assertTrue(final['story.ended'])
            self.assertTrue(final['story.outcome'])

An offline, story-first mini-adventure set at a family campsite. Mira borrows Dad’s lantern to help her frightened little brother Kit find his missing stuffed fox, Pip, before supper. The generated route has exactly seven or eight compatible scenes. Each paragraph is an authored local play rendered from actions that changed the shared state.

## Run it

From the repository root:

```sh
python -m storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world --seed 0 --scenes 8
python -m storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world --seed 41 --scenes 7
python -m unittest storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.test_world
python check_pack.py .
```

The CLI prints prose. To override parameters, write a JSON object to a file and pass `--params /path/to/overrides.json`; omitted fields use the seeded defaults. For example:

```sh
printf '{"toy_site":"fern_hollow","kit_memory":"fern_hollow","daylight_minutes":0,"lantern_charge":1,"toy_covered":true,"ground_wet":true,"search_policy":"conserve"}' > /tmp/found.json
python -m storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world --seed 0 --scenes 8 --params /tmp/found.json
```

## Explicit ending recipes

A recovered-toy ending is guaranteed by aligned memory: `toy_site='fern_hollow'`, `kit_memory='fern_hollow'`, `daylight_minutes=0`, `lantern_charge=1`, `toy_covered=True`, `ground_wet=True`, `search_policy='conserve'`. The lantern illuminates the remembered site, Kit recovers Pip, and the siblings return by campfire glow if they have no charge left.

A complete comfort-without-the-toy ending is guaranteed by a mistaken memory and no resources for a second look: `toy_site='fern_hollow'`, `kit_memory='tent_edge'`, `daylight_minutes=0`, `lantern_charge=1`, `toy_covered=False`, `ground_wet=True`, `search_policy='sweep'`. The first search spends the only lantern charge; no daylight remains for the other site. The children return safely and Kit accepts a blanket rather than being left with an unresolved, conditional promise.

For a consequential second-sweep success, use `toy_site='fern_hollow'`, `kit_memory='tent_edge'`, `daylight_minutes=0`, `lantern_charge=2`, `search_policy='sweep'`. Changing only the policy to `conserve` produces the loss ending: the battery and dark do not permit another look after the first sweep.

These recipes can be passed directly in Python as `Parameters(...)`, or encoded as JSON overrides for the CLI. The parameter set is validated: actual toy site, Kit’s remembered site, remaining daylight, lantern charge, whether the toy is covered, wet ground, and Mira’s search policy all affect enacted actions or outcomes.

## World and limits

The state distinguishes Dad’s ownership of the lantern from the siblings’ temporary custody. It tracks its charge, whether it is lit, where it is held, toy location, the children’s shared location, fear and courage, search progress, and the route home. The shadow and reflector scenes are optional vignettes; omitting one does not apply its effects elsewhere. A seven-scene route selects one vignette; an eight-scene route selects both.

The bounded seeded search explores compatible scene orders before committing a route. Each local action uses `storyscenes.mini_adventures.local_play.LocalPlay`, validates a candidate state before commit, and records equality requirements and changed values. Failed actions do not mutate the caller’s state. Search branches are speculative only; rejected routes are not narrated. Replay rebuilds the same action trace and prose.

This is a deliberately small model, not a general campsite physics engine. The search policy is an authored choice, the two toy sites are abstractions, and the lantern’s battery is represented in discrete units. The scenes do not model every handoff, tent peg, or cooking action. The generated prose has not been human-rated, and route compatibility is not a guarantee of literary quality.
